text:
alex.k: FYI - noticed a permission gap after the RBAC refactor. A support engineer (non-admin) could view org-level rate/quota dashboard and cost metrics. Repro steps attached. @sec-oncall
monica.g: omg, good catch. can you paste repro steps?
alex.k: Steps:
1) login as support@redwood
2) go /console/orgs/123/usage
3) dashboard loads with cost/limit controls (buttons enabled)
liam.s: that sounds like a role-mapping change. the migration script replaced `billing_read` check with `usage:read` which may be granted to support roles
sophia.r: if true, this is an authorization bug. immediate mitigation: remove `usage:read` from support role or gate dashboard behind `org.admin` until fix :lock:
alex.k: running quick check now
audit-bot: RoleMappingService migration applied by deploy-bot at 1798503200 - changed mapping for role "support"
audit-bot: before: [tickets:write, alerts:read]
audit-bot: after: [tickets:write, alerts:read, usage:read]
liam.s: found the bad line in migration diff: `support.roles += usage:read` - intended to be project-scoped but got applied globally. PR #4321 contains the change
sophia.r: hotfix plan: revoke the global `usage:read` for the support role and add a guard to the dashboard endpoint requiring `billing:org:view`
monica.g: hotfix SQL (run with audit):
```
BEGIN;
UPDATE role_mappings
SET scopes = array_remove(scopes, 'usage:read')
WHERE role = 'support' AND org_id IS NULL;
COMMIT;
```
liam.s: run a count first, capture affected rows, and snapshot `role_mappings` table. I'll open a rollback PR and push to staging for verification
alex.k: also need to list users who accessed billing dashboards since deployment (migration window)
audit-bot: Query executed: SELECT user_id, timestamp, resource FROM audit_events WHERE event_type='dashboard.view' AND resource ILIKE '%/usage%' AND timestamp > to_timestamp(1798503000); returned 18 rows
sophia.r: action items: 1) hotfix SQL 2) RBAC patch to scope `usage:read` to project 3) add endpoint guard requiring `billing:org:view` 4) add alert for abnormal dashboard access patterns 5) notify compliance and affected customers if PII/costs exported
sec-oncall: @ops this is security-sensitive. Do not rotate KMS keys yet. Make sure KMS audit logs are preserved and exported to retention bucket. Also enable stricter access on the analytics S3 for now.
monica.g: timeline proposal: hotfix now -> monitor 30m -> deploy RBAC patch -> postmortem + customer notif if confirmed exposure. I'll kickoff the incident channel and notify compliance. :eyes:
liam.s: I'll draft the PR w/ unit/integration tests that assert `dashboard.view` requires `billing:org:view` for org endpoints and `usage:read` remains valid for project endpoints only
alex.k: thanks. Also create a detection rule in Console to flag anyone with `usage:read` AND `org_id IS NULL` going forward
sophia.r: starting postmortem template, will include timeline, root cause (migration scoping bug), remediation, tests added, and followups for RBAC migration tooling
alex.k: ping when SQL applied and when PR is ready. good triage everyone :thumbsup:
